gateName: Release 11 Production Malware-Scanning Gate & Quarantine Storage Isolation

governanceStatus.finalProductionStatus: NOT APPROVED (PENDING DEVOPS CLOUD SCANNER INFRASTRUCTURE PROVISIONING)

storageConfiguration.quarantineAccess: Zero public access, zero customer direct access, zero pre-signed URLs without scan certification
storageConfiguration.informationDisclosureDefense: quarantineKey, quarantineBucket, and cleanStorageKey are strictly omitted from Mongoose toJSON transforms and API responses

scannerIntegrationConfiguration.adapterBoundary: MalwareScannerService / LocalQuarantineStorageAdapter / Production Cloud Scanner Adapter
scannerIntegrationConfiguration.authentication: HMAC-SHA256 signature via x-scanner-signature header with 5-minute replay freshness window via x-scanner-timestamp header

lifecycle.action: File stored in quarantineBucket, download blocked (HTTP 423)
Promoted to cleanVaultBucket, sha256 recorded, scanExpiresAt set (30 days), short-lived tokenized downloads enabled
Permanently blocked (HTTP 403), malware signature logged, quarantine retention cleanup scheduled
Download blocked (HTTP 423), retry queue event dispatched

pending.message: Attachment is currently undergoing security scanning and is not yet available for download

clean.message: Attachment authorized for download with short-lived HMAC tokenized URL (15 min expiry)

malicious.message: Attachment was identified as malicious and has been quarantined. Access is permanently blocked.

scan_failed.message: Attachment malware scanning failed. Download is blocked until security verification completes.

expired.message: Attachment security scan verdict has expired. Re-scanning is required before download.

callbackAuthenticationAndIdempotency.idempotencyMechanism: Atomic database query checking existing verdict and sha256. Replayed callbacks return HTTP 200 with status: 'idempotent_noop' without duplicating audit events or state
callbackAuthenticationAndIdempotency.tenantSafety: CustomerRequest.findOne({ _id: requestId, clientId }) ensures scanner event cannot modify attachments in another tenant

cleanupAndFailureBehavior.quarantineRetention: Quarantine objects purged automatically after 7 days if unverified or malicious
cleanupAndFailureBehavior.cleanRetention: Clean files retained per client data policy; scan verdicts re-evaluated every 30 days
cleanupAndFailureBehavior.timeoutPolicy: Scanner webhook timeout set to 30 seconds; if no verdict within 5 minutes, attachment remains locked in pending with auto-retry
cleanupAndFailureBehavior.scannerUnavailable: Fail-closed default: if scanner service is down, downloads remain HTTP 423 locked

externalInfrastructurePrerequisites.description: Create isolated S3/GCS bucket `flumenx-quarantine-isolated` with zero public access, bucket policy disallowing GetObject except to the scanning worker, and 7-day lifecycle purge rule.
Create S3/GCS bucket `flumenx-clean-vault` with SSE-KMS encryption and IAM restricted access.
Deploy ClamAV / AWS GuardDuty / GCP Cloud Storage Scanner container configured with SQS/PubSub notification on quarantine bucket uploads.
Configure `SCANNER_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in production secret store (AWS Secrets Manager / GCP Secret Manager) and inject into backend environment.
Run EICAR test string upload in production staging environment to verify active quarantine, malicious verdict callback, and HTTP 403 gating.
